title: Nyan Cat
description: This mod adds the only Nyan Cat
body:
# Nyan Cat
This mod adds Nyan Cat!

He spawns naturally in the world. You can ride it to fly in the skies and to listen his music!

Just a little tip: don't attack him, or he'll get a lot angry! 
Ah, and be ready to some jumpscares!

> Made with [MCreator](https://mcreator.net)
